NNSA: eighteen mixed-type entries distinguish sites, facilities, project umbrellas, subprojects, a scope strategy, a capacity plan, a first-unit event and an independent recommendation. Parent links and nearby entries do not establish accepted capability or enterprise-baseline sufficiency.
